_comment: Loads into crm_tickets. Past support history — establishes tone preference, the known clearance issue, and one prior claim so the second-occurrence rule in POL-DMG-001 has a baseline to compare against.

tickets.subject: Atlas Mid Tower too tight for a 332mm card
tickets.resolution: Return approved and refunded in full. Advised moving up to the Full Tower for GPU clearance.
tickets.notes: Customer was easy to work with and wanted a quick answer, not a long explanation.

tickets.subject: Does the Titan CPU come with a cooler?
tickets.resolution: Confirmed it ships without a cooler and needs a 280mm liquid cooler or better at 350W. Pointed at the Frostline 360mm.
tickets.notes: Answered from the knowledge base, no tool calls needed.

tickets.subject: Where is my order?
tickets.resolution: Tracking had not updated for 36 hours. Explained normal carrier lag; parcel delivered the next day.
tickets.notes: Mild frustration at the tracking gap. Resolved without escalation.

tickets.subject: Graphics card sag and support bracket
tickets.resolution: Explained the anti-sag bracket ships in the box with the RX-800 and how to fit it to the case rail.
tickets.notes: Bought the RX-800 recently and is careful about how it is installed.
